original_method: Certify every path element for Gen6 and pin Speed Change 46; for each numbered cycle prove full-width Gen4, request Gen6, capture equalization/LTSSM and settled width plus error/health deltas, stop before the next cycle on any unsupported, incomplete, or failed result, and recover through the approved console path.

required_inputs: Positive Gen6/full-width capability evidence for every path component and firmware
Per-cycle Gen4 entry and Gen6 request/equalization/LTSSM/settle/width/error rules
500-count, abort, final-state, artifact-integrity, and recovery policy
safety_requirements: No execution or register forcing without positive Gen6 support
Dedicated SUT with stable power/cooling and out-of-band console

Run only the approved Speed Change 46 operation
Fail closed before the next cycle
Do not infer support, force speed, accept downgrade, clear evidence, retry, or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Certify Gen6 path and Speed Change 46 semantics
Review all 500 results and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED
